confidence_notes: May and October 2026 city price averages bracket July; local-currency conversion is approximate. Cocktail follows a current aggregate estimate and its relationship to local beer; wine by the glass is inferred from beer and local bottle-wine prices. July accommodation estimates are holistic and especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external comparable city used. Food and drink follow Punta del Este price averages; accommodation reflects its coastal-resort setting in the July winter off-season.
